title: Myanmar’s anti-drug crackdown: Authorities torch USD 600 million worth of seized narcotics
summary: On the UN's International Day Against Drug Abuse, Myanmar incinerated over 50 tonnes of narcotics, valued at $600 million. This year's destruction effort is double that of last year's, emphasizing the country’s ongoing struggle as a key drug producer amidst conflict and inadequate governance.
